correctness.rationale: Plancherel gives an exact Fourier integral. For common bias p, each squared characteristic-function factor is cos²(wθ/2)+(1−2p)²sin²(wθ/2). Expanding yields coefficients that are integrals of positive almost-everywhere products for nonzero integer weights, hence all strictly positive. Normalization follows by summing the factors, the complete-monotone derivative formula is an exact polynomial derivative, and the sharp chord envelope and equality cases follow termwise. The standalone checker independently passed 9,681 exact-rational assertions; the universal proof requires no finite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The inspected 2026 weighted-Bernoulli sources cover Shannon-entropy conjectures or fair-input comparisons among Rényi orders, rather than a positive-coefficient bias polynomial, all-order variance-parameter sign hierarchy and sharp global envelope for all overlapping integer weights. Unit-weight binomial and up-to-four-weight results are insufficient to imply the general statement. Search supports a differentiated claim but cannot rule out older spectral formulations.

value.rationale: Collision probability is both a natural order-two entropy invariant and the two-sample meeting probability for the recently proposed recursive overlap Bernoulli model. The theorem controls every positive integer overlap profile and every bias without asymptotics, proving strict alternating signs for all derivatives and an exact sharp global quadratic envelope. It provides a rigorous structural analogue and explicit bounds in an area where Shannon concavity remains conjectural; it does not claim to solve that stronger conjecture.
